## What changes

Describe the concrete behavior and whether it is implemented, simulated or only planned.

## Validation

List offline checks and any hardware tested, including controller identity/firmware.
Do not describe untested hardware behavior as verified.

## Controller impact

State whether this changes telemetry only, temporary settings, saved configuration,
firmware or motor behavior. Include rollback/recovery details when applicable.

## Handoff

Update current status, unresolved decisions and the next useful task when they change.
